fact_english: The binturong, found in Palawan, gives off a scent often compared to buttered popcorn.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang binturong ng Palawan, may amoy na madalas ikumpara sa popcorn na may mantikilya!

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Hayop na amoy-sinehan. Sige, tatabihan ko.

after_text: Uminit ang medalyon ni M, mabagal, parang ayaw.
why_here: After 'Uminit ang medalyon ni M, mabagal, parang ayaw.': the slow jump leaves the viewer waiting for where it lands.
